observations: Handler fault requires opt-in env plus explicit diagnostic frame and occurs after identity/dedupe/pause/safe-state checks but before sendUserMessage.
The message is stored unknown before throw, so no success ACK/enqueue occurs and same-process reconnect retains unknown_no_replay.
Independent actual OMP tests verify a new socket with the same PID/session/generation, old-message no-replay, and a distinct fresh message exactly once.
Env-only, no-env diagnostic, malformed JSON, and false-ACK mutations discriminate activation and false success.
No delta invalidates prior G3 delivery/contention/session/reconnect/pause/async-error evidence.
residual_limits: Outage evidence covers a request begun with no peer, not post-send ACK-loss ambiguity or production host queue policy.
Disconnected events are inferred from isolated provider counts and post-recovery state because the socket cannot carry events during outage.
Fault injection is bounded pre-enqueue; arbitrary post-enqueue crash and durable process-restart recovery remain outside CW-04.
